items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: and Jose, the bass player, you know Jose, he was the bass player

ctx.x: Yeah, that'd be painful, that'd be hurt and soft.

And I don't know whether George ever told you this. No, no. We was in Crystal Spring, we was going, we hadn't been to the hall, coming back. I know we thought we'd take the shot because we were with some girls you know. And I jumped down the clip, we both fell down the clip. Me and me. He never told you about it? I went down the clip, the saxophone player went down the clip, and my trumpet, I bent my trumpet, he broke the neck off the banjo, and pointed out, bent his saxophone, and Jose, the bass player, you know…
It was great. Yeah, lucky they got prepared that.
